title: Finite polynomial rings preserve regularity
statement: Let $C$ be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] and let $s\ge0$. Then the polynomial ring $C[z_1,\ldots,z_s]$ is a regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme].

polynomial ring over a regular ring is a regular ring
